source: dt25 g1-F1: OpenClaw 2026.11.2 on the Linux test box — the installer's ~/.local/bin/openclaw sh wrapper (primary) runs the package of the same-version v24.16.0 nvm copy, and the gateway unit (systemd; LaunchAgent on macOS) runs that package directly. Every CLI copy counts as the agent's own whatever its version, so the unit is the agent's own service (info); the installer's .bak / .receipt.bak copies are never loaded by systemd and are not judged
